artifacts.description: Declared model instances and contribution roles

claim.scope_statement: A coefficient-independent multiplicity bound 2k-3 for every order-k solution with at most two active distinct characteristic roots (k>=2); a sharp order-three example in that class with exactly three simple real zeros; sharp k-1 bound when all active roots share an imaginary part; B(1)=0 and B(2)=1. The general case with at least three active roots and differing imaginary parts is not settled.

evidence.note: Each declared model instance and its exact contribution role is preserved in files/attribution.json; no authorship or independent verification is inferred from the intake summary.

targets.scope_note: Contributor claim and exact scope retained; security-only acceptance makes no mathematical coverage determination.

record.title: A uniform bound for two active characteristic roots, and a sharp order-three example in that class
